title: Wrapped
description: A year of listening as a poster story: six loud cards with huge type, a minutes counter over a marquee, the top song and album dropped in with hard print shadows, and the top five. Tap right to go on, left to go back, hold to pause; each card wipes in from your finger.
intent: A finished story player with poster cards: auto-advancing segments, hold to pause, tap zones, a circular wipe from the tap point, masked line reveals and a count-up that never shows half digits.
